text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff... I'm back.
choice_data_list: Good work, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I feel I did enough to leave no regrets behind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... I'm sorry.
As expected... it's taking a while to catch my breath.
choice_data_list: I have water. Room temperature and cold...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you very much. In that case, I'd like the cold one, please.
choice_data_list: Do you need salt too? Ah, and energy as well...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I knew you were traveling with quite a lot of luggage,
but still..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for preparing so meticulously.
...Just as expected of you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Ah, no! Maybe that was a bit of an exaggeration—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, that's a big help. Salt and energy, please.
I need to properly prepare
for the Winning Live, after all.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. I'm just glad it helped.

text_block_list.text: She was the only one who never laughed at my overly serious nature. My debut race with Air Messiah came to a close with fantastic results.

The day after the Make Debut. After returning to the academy by Shinkansen,
we held a meeting in our usual Trainer's room.
The agenda was—
choice_data_list: This is about our next target race, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Of course, I understand that this is something
best decided early on, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have a proposal. Before that, how about
we take a period of rest?

In the pleasant, mild weather, the breeze quietly sways the leaves.
Beside me, Air Messiah's chest rose and fell softly,
as if breathing in the dense scent of greenery.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accepting my proposal,
Trainer. And also for accompanying
me today.
choice_data_list: No. Resting is definitely important too.
No. Taking a break is definitely important, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Personally, that is an area
where I am quite particular.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Steadily, surely. In building things up step by step,
what becomes crucial is the 'power of persistence.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And in order to 'continue,'
sometimes it is vital to 'stop' by your own choice.
So that you do not come to an unintended 'halt.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That is how I see it.
choice_data_list: I think that's an important way of thinking. I'll follow your example.
I think that's an important way of thinking. I'll follow your example, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hearing you say that makes me feel rather proud.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Since we're here,
would you like to check out that area over there too?

Looking in the direction Air Messiah pointed,
I unfolded the park map I grabbed at the entrance.
If I recall, in that direction lies—
choice_data_list: There's a flower bed? Sounds good, let's go!
There's a flower bed? Nice, let's go!

text_block_list.text:
“—And then, Sweep-san went and...
Wait, ah?!”

Wah, it's Messiah-san and the others!
Heyyy, helloooo!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Craft-san... and everyone else too.
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Really! We were just taking a break from our run right now~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Are you and Messiah refreshing yourselves here?
If I recall correctly, you submitted a request for a rest day today, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh, once again, congrats on your Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Following Heart-san and Craft-san,
I managed to pull through safely as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That run was just so like Messiah-san.
Intelligent, cool... and sharp!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Though my debut timing fell behind the others,
I can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I shall be watching your debut race closely as well,
Cesario-san."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Next year... as one of the rivals we must watch out for
on the Classic-tier Triple Tiara route.

Rhein Kraft, Daring Heart, and Cesario.
In the same grade and class, seemingly on great terms, they—

If they debut in the same class like this,
these Umamusume will become rivals competing
for the singular crown of the "Triple Tiara."

"Yes. They all, just like Air Messiah,
are striving to grasp that magnificent crown—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone, what kind of autumn flowers do you like?
I mean, look, so many are blooming right now!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"For me, I'd say cosmos flowers!
They're so delicate and cute—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, their lovely vibe kinda reminds me of the Tiara Umamusume!
And also how there are sooooo many colors!
More than anyone, Rhein Kraft seemed to hold a deep longing to be a "Tiara Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to bloom in my own colors too.
Just like the cosmos flowers. And just like
all the senior Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I'll deliver my running into someone's heart.
So strong and dazzling that it stays with them forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: As for me—well, if we're talking autumn flowers, it'd have to be the dahlia!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful how delightfully gorgeous this flower is, isn't it?
So brilliant, so dignified.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A flower fit for a 'Queen.'
In other words, a flower fit for me!"

An exchange student, as well as a noble, cheerful elite.
Daring Heart smiles gracefully.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So, if I'm getting a bouquet, I'd want something super vivid♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even so, my own brilliance will not fade.
I'll show you that I can become the most magnificent Queen!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For me... globe amaranth, perhaps.
It's often used in dried flower arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“Immortal,” “undying.”
Never ever fading away—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That can truly be called my ideal form.

Possessing a striking duality between "On" and "Off"...
as well as an overwhelmingly high perspective and immense ability—Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly adorned and still shining to this day—
the history of the Tiara Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To become an Umamusume who kindles a new light there.
To become a cornerstone Tiara Umamusume—I surely will, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...Those two
will surely be our greatest obstacle going forward.
choice_data_list: Looks like she's going to be... pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, truly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Both the resolve to seek the Tiara—
and of course, the strength to match.
They possess both without a single flaw.

I nod deeply. The mock race between Air Messiah
and Cesario that I watched before signing the contract
comes rushing back to mind. That sharpness, that burst of speed—
On top of that, I was able to hear Daring Heart and Rhein Kraft's outlook on their futures earlier, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I hear both of you have set your main sights on the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies...
one of the Junior Division GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With her sights set on next year's Triple Tiara... it seems she's already taking on the highest echelon of racing.
choice_data_list: Ah...
Yeah...

text_block_list.text:
"So then, what should we do?"
In the end, that was the question one couldn't help but ponder.
To stand against rivals who already radiate such immense pressure—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let's prepare.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just fully prepared. To the utmost of our ability.
—In our own way.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It won't change.
In fact, I believe it must not change,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, if we can say the preparations are complete,
entering a race would be a fine choice.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, our greatest goal
is next year's Triple Tiara.
We must produce results there, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"So for now, let us prepare.
Accumulating training and experience, step by step."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...I think that's the best way forward too.
Yeah. ...I think that's the best option too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...That's the best outcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then—shall we head back soon?
It's starting to get chilly.
choice_data_list: That's true.

text_block_list.text:
I nod, watching Air Messiah
as she walks away, lost in thought.
choice_data_list: (I need to... get on firmer footing myself.)
(I need to... find a more solid footing myself.)

text_block_list.text:
"One step at a time, steadily and surely."
So that I can say with utmost conviction
that this is the best, and this is the strongest.
For now, all I can do is keep working hard.
